name: 黑暗路基艾尔
title: 黑暗实体
text:
具有邪恶意志的黑暗实体，在远古黑暗火花战争中把怪兽与奥特战士变成火花人偶。与银河战平后等待复活机会，随后吸收负面能量再度现身，用黑暗力量及黑暗火花发射的光线攻击。

身高：微型至无限大（无可用有限尺）。体重：未知（原字段0至无限大，未写单位）。
version_scope: 只银河原版；火花人偶状态有文字但静态未齐，不混维克特路基艾尔。

fact_sources.original_description: An entity of darkness with an evil will. The one responsible for transforming monsters and the Ultras into Spark Dolls in the Dark Spark Wars that unfolded in the galaxy far away in ancient times. Although it fought to a draw with Ultraman Ginga, it was waiting for a chance to revive. It was revived by gaining Minus Energy and attacked Ginga with powerful dark powers. Fires out beams from the Dark Spark, which power is comparable to the Strium Beam.
